coverage_gaps: Settlement House did not provide reusable local event or facility photos with explicit publication permission, so both images are clearly labeled rights-cleared illustrations from outside Corona.
Holiday basket and toy-recipient figures are attributed to the organization’s current program page and were not independently audited.
The organization’s pages do not state Thanksgiving-week closures; readers are advised to call before visiting.
Eligibility documentation and appointment requirements are not fully described on the public pages.
